need: Hazard row, same work, other rendering: the same Zotero item also holds the Internet Archive's plain-text OCR of this book, 693 823 characters of it, and Zotero did index the first 500 000. The body really is in the index. But the local API serves /items/<key>/fulltext only for cached MIME types — PDF, HTML, EPUB — so text/plain answers 404 and the export carries no fulltext file for it. Indexed and unreadable are not the same failure, and this item shows both at once: the served rendering has no book text, the rendering with the book text is not served.
